test.create_query: CREATE TABLE prewhere_combine_filters (a UInt8, b UInt8, c UInt8, d UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE prewhere_combine_filters_string (a UInt8, b UInt8, c UInt8, d Date, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO prewhere_combine_filters SELECT intHash32(number) % 100, intHash32(number + 1) % 100, intHash32(number + 2) % 100, number FROM numbers_mt(10000000)

INSERT INTO prewhere_combine_filters_string SELECT intHash32(number) % 100, intHash32(number + 1) % 100, intHash32(number + 2) % 100, toDate('2020-01-01') + intHash32(number + 5) % 100, if(intHash32(number + 3) % 10 = 0, '', concat('https://example.com/', toString(intHash64(number)), '/', repeat('p', intHash32(number + 4) % 64))) FROM numbers_mt(5000000)
